{C:81906101}{C:81958296DE2400000000}...And that's how we drove the enemy back.
Afterward, Mamoru went with Galeon
to see how the other continents are doing.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296DF2400000000}You must be very powerful to have driven them back.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296E02400000000}That was thanks to the Ganba Team's efforts.
We couldn't have managed
on our own.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E12400000000}The Ganba Team...
Are they the pilots
of that big robot we saw earlier?

{C:81958296E22400000000}Where are the people who pilot it?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296E32400000000}Come to think of it...

{C:81905801}{C:81958296E42400000000}They were fighting over there.

the Ganba Team later.

{C:81958296F72400000000}But I'm sorry to ask that you stay

{C:81909602}{C:81958296192500000000}This is your fault, Kotaro.

{C:81909202}{C:819582961A2500000000}I couldn't help it!
I thought they were enemies!

{C:81909402}{C:819582961B2500000000}The Chief wasn't angry,

{C:819582961C2500000000}Besides, it's careless

{C:81930100}{C:819582961D2500000000}Oh, so you're the Ganba Team

{C:81909D02}{C:819582962C2500000000}Impossible! Why?!

{C:81909502}{C:819582962D2500000000}I've got it!
This isn't our world,

{C:81909702}{C:819582962E2500000000}Really, Yosuke?!

{C:81909502}{C:819582962F2500000000}Huh? Well, I don't have any proof.

{C:81909D02}{C:81958296302500000000}If my magic doesn't work,

{C:81958296312500000000}Ganba Team,
I'll let you off for today!
Farewell!


{C:81909302}{C:81958296322500000000}If the curse doesn't work,
we don't have to worry about anything!

{C:81909702}{C:81958296332500000000}All right!
We'll fight to our hearts' content!!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296342500000000}Um, wait a moment...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296362500000000}Oh, Guy!
Did you find anything out?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296372500000000}Yes.
All we learned was that Volfogg
was taken out by someone.

{C:81958296382500000000}There weren't any clues at all.
I'm at a loss.
How about you?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296392500000000}We saw some strange things,
but nothing in particular happened.

{C:81905401}{C:819582963A2500000000}I see...
Then why don't you come with me to 
{C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000} this time?

{C:819582963B2500000000}My cousin {C:819782830400}Renais{C:819782830000} is there.
She might have some information.

{C:81900300}{C:819582963C2500000000}Yes, that sounds good.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296DC2500000000}You're the captain...

{C:81958296DE2500000000}It seems we share a goal.
I'm coming aboard too.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DF2500000000}Um, excuse me...?


{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296E02500000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Heero Yuy.{C:819782830000}
I'm an MS pilot.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E12500000000}Hey, you!
What do you think you're doing?!

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296E22500000000}I told you we share a goal.
If you can't believe me,
then don't.

{C:81958296E42500000000}I'll fight Posaydal's army,
even if I have to do it alone.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E72500000000}What?!
Will you please say something?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E82500000000}Hmm...


{C:81900300}{C:81958296E92500000000}Oh!
You feel it too, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB2500000000}I do.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296EC2500000000}What's with you two?!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296ED2500000000}Sorry, sorry.

{C:81958296EE2500000000}My brother and I
don't know why, but we feel
we can trust Heero.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF2500000000}That's right.
I feel as though
I've known him for a long time.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296F02500000000}You too...?
When I look at you,
I feel something familiar too...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F22500000000}Then it's all right
to let Heero aboard, isn't it?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F32500000000}If that's what you both think,
there's no point in my objecting.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296F42500000000}Then I can stay here?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F52500000000}Yes, Heero.
Please lend us your strength.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296F62500000000}Understood...

{C:81905701}{C:81958296FA2500000000}Guuuy!!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296FB2500000000}Mikoto!!
I'm so glad you're safe.

{C:81905701}{C:81958296FC2500000000}{C:819782830400}Domon Kasshu{C:819782830000}
saved me.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296FE2500000000}I just couldn't forgive
Posaydal's army for its cowardice.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296FF2500000000}You still saved her.
Thank you, Domon Kasshu.
How can I repay you?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296002600000000}Well, if I may be selfish,
I'd like to come aboard
your ship too.

{C:81958296032600000000}I'm looking for someone,
but without a means of transport,
there's not much I can do.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296042600000000}What do you think?
Could you let him aboard?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296052600000000}I don't mind.
What do you think, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296062600000000}If someone strong wants to join us,
I have no reason to object, but...

{C:81905401}{C:81958296072600000000}But?



{C:8190B601}{C:819582960B2600000000}Ah, Domooon!!
So this is where you were!!

{C:8190B501}{C:819582960C2600000000}R-Rain!
Where have you been?!

{C:819582960D2600000000}I couldn't send out
{C:819782830400}God Gundam{C:819782830000}
because you weren't here!

{C:8190B601}{C:819582960F2600000000}What?!
You're the one who ran off
somewhere with Master!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296102600000000}Sorry to interrupt your argument,
but we're rather busy.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296112600000000}Oh, I'm sorry.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296122600000000}Domon,
you have permission to come aboard,
so please settle your argument quickly.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296132600000000}Oh, right.

{C:81906101}{C:819582961A2600000000}Welcome back, brave heroes!
Posaydal's army has withdrawn
from our continent!

{C:81909302}{C:819582961B2600000000}Of course it has!
We were fighting too!

{C:81909502}{C:819582961C2600000000}But Guy,
you managed to combine successfully
even with such low odds.

{C:81905401}{C:819582961E2600000000}Yes.
But more than the successful combination,
I'm relieved that Mikoto's safe.

{C:819582961F2600000000}And that was all thanks to you.
Thank you, everyone!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296202600000000}So...
what are you going to do now?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296212600000000}We're pursuing {C:819782830400}Norstan{C:819782830000},
a ship with the same shape as ours.

{C:81958296242600000000}The Cloud Sea seems to have opened up,
so we'd like to go to another continent.

{C:81905801}{C:81958296252600000000}Oh, you're leaving already?
I'll miss you!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296262600000000}Chief, could I go
with them too?

{C:81958296272600000000}They saved this continent.
I'd like to help them, even a little.

{C:81905701}{C:81958296282600000000}But if Guy leaves, 
{C:819782830300}Brave{C:819782830000}--what will happen to it?


{C:81906101}{C:81958296292600000000}I don't think we need to worry.
On the contrary, by going beyond this continent,
they should be able to keep the enemy in check.

{C:81905401}{C:819582962A2600000000}Chief, then...?!

{C:81906101}{C:819582962B2600000000}That's right, Guy!
Heroes know no borders!
Go and fight to save the world!!

{C:81905401}{C:819582962C2600000000}Mikoto... I'm sorry.
I'm going to fight alongside them.


{x00}
